label: 2. I was doing a show today,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I was doing a show today,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: when all of a sudden, a fan leaped onto the stage.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'd run that very situation over countless times in my head,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: going over how I'd respond.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: When it actually happened though, I blanked out.
Were you hurt?
What did they do after getting on stage?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: No, I'm okay.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I wasn't in any danger to begin with.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: He'd had a few too many,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: and he's such a big fan of my music,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: he just wanted to dance on stage.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: So that's what we did.
Must have been fun.
Must have been awkward.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Fun and awkward.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: A little bit of both.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I was also jealous.
Jealous?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: It's not easy to just let your body go

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: and give in to the music without caring what other people think.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'm sure you can agree with me on that.
Absolutely. It's very hard.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: nowadays the media covers every single move you make.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'm always reluctant to really let myself go.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Tonight felt so different.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I need to learn how to just go with the flow more often.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You and I can work on it together.
Sounds like a plan.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: All right then, see you later.
